method: Editorial evidence-based readiness rubric, not a vendor score, ranking probability or measured platform visibility. Each dimension has five criteria out of 20. Missing evidence earns no implied credit; scores are judgment calls supported by the audit.
implemented: GEO implementation released through PR #5 at dfd364d and verified publicly; editorial readiness scores are not measured ranking or citation effects.

dimensions.name: GEO readiness
criteria: Server HTML, access, sitemap and source paths
Core packaging/textile definition and order scope
Seven new guides, existing hubs retained
Four new worksheets and original tables/examples
No new external proof or mentions established

dimensions.name: SEO readiness
criteria: Contextual hub/method links and workflow connections
Expanded cost/MOQ guides and substantial new intents

Search retrieval and local/public homepage Lighthouse observed; actual indexing and field CWV remain unmeasured. Conservative score retained because isolated lab runs cannot establish site-wide field performance.

dimensions.name: Entity authority
criteria: Named founder and contact; exact legal entities still missing
Packaging/textiles; China; U.S. customers; no invented infrastructure
Method, editorial policy and operational decision records
Published founder experience retained; no case study evidence added

dimensions.name: AI citation readiness
criteria: Supplier, QC, fees, comparison, Canton and project briefs
Distinct organization authorship, visible updates and primary-source links
No external research or client outcomes invented

dimensions.name: Conversion readiness
criteria: Existing category landing pages and guide/service pathways
Current product supply model preserved and explained
Dedicated contact route, optional fields, tested delivery logic
Budget, market, customization, supplier status and timing in brief
Offline CRM/ad conversion import not connected; no live test lead sent
